independently_discovered_opportunities: Reconcile multiple exact receipts without silently promoting inconsistent dependencies.
Bind the immutable final archive only after packaging through a detached, reproducible, cross-checked delivery receipt.

product_platform_improvements.problem: v1.7.80 could validate only one receipt at a time and did not detect conflicts or replay across a proposed launch evidence set.
product_platform_improvements.implementation: Added an owner-only batch evidence workspace that validates up to 32 exact nonsecret receipts, rejects duplicate IDs/digests, component conflicts, mixed environments, stale or tampered members, and emits a deterministic all-or-nothing promotion transaction preview. It never persists receipts, calls providers, mutates the register, infers owner GO, writes, deploys, or activates production.
product_platform_improvements.before_state: Owner review required separate receipt previews with no batch-level reconciliation.
product_platform_improvements.after_state: A complete proposed evidence set can be checked for internal consistency and reviewed as one non-applicable transaction preview.
product_platform_improvements.benefit: Reduces owner review effort while preventing partial, conflicting, replayed, or cross-environment evidence from appearing promotable.
limitations: No evidence is persisted or applied; exact external receipts remain unavailable.

builder_prompt_system_improvements.problem: v1.7.80 required manual post-package reporting and did not provide one deterministic detached final delivery receipt with cross-receipt verification.
builder_prompt_system_improvements.implementation: Added a post-package generator and verifier that compares two immutable final archives and binds final SHA-256/size to accepted candidate identity, source artifact, package/lock/SBOM, V14 and legacy inventories, owner receipt, and test-log evidence across seventeen required fields. The receipt is written outside the final ZIP.
builder_prompt_system_improvements.before_state: Final identity was reported manually after packaging.
builder_prompt_system_improvements.after_state: One deterministic command creates a detached receipt and fails closed on twin mismatch, candidate/final reuse, or any embedded evidence mismatch.
builder_prompt_system_improvements.future_build_benefit: Makes delivered outer-archive identity reproducible and auditable without self-reference.
limitations: Receipt generation can occur only after candidate acceptance, source sealing, and immutable final packaging.

reverted_or_rejected_innovation_waves: Receipt persistence, provider access, partial promotion, writes, deployment, and production activation were rejected.
lessons_carried_forward: Single-receipt validation is insufficient for a multi-dependency launch decision.
Final archive identity must remain detached but should be automatically cross-checked against embedded evidence.

prior_limitations_reviewed.disposition: Preserved; connector validates only supplied evidence and performs no external action.
